notes.title: Big update just landed!
notes.notes:
[h1]Hi![/h1]

After a long break, we’re back with a new update! It took a while, but last year was tough for the game development industry. As a small studio, we also faced challenging times. Fortunately, the worst is behind us, and we’re excited to present the new update.

[h2]What’s new:[/h2]
[u]Bug fixes – Thank you for reporting them![/u]

[b]Achievements[/b] – You can now earn Steam achievements for your progress in the game. Collect them all!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41245375/6780f78afeb55542307530b8bc4a686345902d7a.png[/img]
[b]Unstuck feature[/b] – We’ve added a button to the menu to fix the issue of getting stuck on the map.
[b]German language version[/b] – Another language option is now available!

[b][u]We hope you have a great time playing and look forward to bringing you more updates soon.[/u][/b]

[b]Best regards,
The White Pig Games Team[/b]

notes.title: First Update
notes.notes:
[b]¡Hola amigos![/b]

¡Los invitamos a resolver los misterios de los accidentes aéreos! ¡A partir de hoy, el juego está disponible en español! ¡Diviértanse!

[b]This is the first news in today's update - the Spanish language version![/b]

Additionally:
[list]
[*] We have improved the desert stage - according to your suggestions.
[*] We have fixed the Goldberg mission - it should not get stuck at one of the clues.
[*] We have corrected the CHINESE and ENGLISH language versions - based on your feedback.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41245375/e7d26f374621ed302149a43242a0a29fea60f2c1.gif[/img]
Thank you very much for your feedback, as you can see, we are able to improve the game based on it. We are very grateful for this!

[u]More fixes - coming soon![/u]
[b]
Best regards,
White Pig Games team[/b]

notes.title: LAST WEEKEND BEFORE THE RELEASE
notes.notes:
Are you ready for the upcoming special weekend?
You might wonder why it's special? Because it's the last one without a PLANE ACCIDENT!

Spend time with friends and family, because starting next Tuesday, the world of unresolved aviation disasters will consume you!

[b]20.02.2024 - TUESDAY - SAVE THE DATE!!![/b]
